FLT-PET/ CT is as good as FDG-PET for detecting nodal and extrahepatic distant metastases, but not for liver metastasis.
FLT-PET/TC is as good as FDG-PET-CT in diagnosing nodal and distant pancreatic cancer metastases, but FLT-PCT is better than FDG-PET in predicting patient survival.
FLT-PET/TC is a promising modality for the detection of pancreatic cancer and its prognostic value is superior to FDG-Pet/CT.

the diagnostic and prognosic value of FLT-PET for pancreatic cancer.
the diagnostic and prognositic value of FLT-PET-CT for pancreatic cancer.
the potential role of FLT-PET as a prognostic tool in patients with pancreatic cancer.
